answer: Each new agent posts a 25-token deposit and answers latency probes from 5 independent witness nodes every 12 rounds. Accounts whose round-trip times match within 2 ms are treated as one cluster, and each extra member raises the cluster deposit by 10 tokens, so n clones cost 25n+5n(n-1). A clone cannot wander off to another datacenter without paying again, since each wharf of witnesses publishes signed timings and any ledge-side auditor can recompute the clusters.
